mapper.insert: INSERT INTO groups (game_id, is_active, is_ended, applicants_count) VALUES (#{gameId}, true, false, 0)
mapper.select: SELECT g.group_id, g.game_id, g.applicants_count, gm.game_datetime, gm.home_team, gm.away_team, gm.stadium FROM groups g JOIN games gm ON g.game_id = gm.game_id WHERE g.is_active = true AND g.is_ended = false AND (gm.home_team = #{baseballTeams, typeHandler=com.ssafy.ticket_backend.handler.BaseballTeamsTypeHandler} OR gm.away_team = #{baseballTeams, typeHandler=com.ssafy.ticket_backend.handler.BaseballTeamsTypeHandler}) ORDER BY gm.game_datetime ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE groups SET applicants_count = applicants_count + 1, is_active = CASE WHEN applicants_count + 1 >= 20 THEN false ELSE is_active END WHERE group_id = #{groupId}
UPDATE groups SET is_ended = true WHERE game_id IN ( SELECT game_id FROM games WHERE game_datetime < NOW() + INTERVAL '7 days' AND is_ended = false ) AND is_ended = false
